preconditions: new object identity is not active
postconditions: create immutable OBSERVATION with status OBSERVED
constitutional_constraints: compiler output is candidate state only
observation admission is not semantic truth

preconditions: target is active OBSERVATION in OBSERVED status
referenced epistemic evidence is admitted when supplied
postconditions: supersede observation with VALIDATED revision
constitutional_constraints: validation does not convert integrity proof into truth proof

preconditions: bound external evidence record exists and is VALIDATED
referenced observations are active and VALIDATED
postconditions: create immutable EVIDENCE with status ADMITTED and exact record/provenance hashes
constitutional_constraints: predicate/evidence binding must remain exact
registry validation is not semantic truth

preconditions: bound external evidence record exists and is REJECTED
postconditions: create immutable EVIDENCE rejection record
constitutional_constraints: rejected evidence cannot be used as admitted support

preconditions: proposition is a non-empty structured mapping
postconditions: create CLAIM ACTIVE and UNVERIFIED
constitutional_constraints: no language string is treated as a conclusion by the VM

postconditions: create BELIEF bound to claim with empty evidence relations
constitutional_constraints: belief creation does not establish verification

postconditions: supersede belief adding exact support evidence relation
constitutional_constraints: old belief remains immutable history

postconditions: supersede belief adding exact contradiction evidence relation
constitutional_constraints: old belief remains immutable history

postconditions: supersede belief adding exact undercut evidence relation
constitutional_constraints: old belief remains immutable history

preconditions: two or more distinct active objects
postconditions: create one merged object and supersede every input
constitutional_constraints: scalar conflicts escalate rather than being guessed

preconditions: partition keys preserve every source field
postconditions: create multiple same-type objects and supersede source to every part
constitutional_constraints: no source content may disappear silently

preconditions: new scope is a strict subset
postconditions: supersede target with narrower scope
constitutional_constraints: narrowing cannot broaden any dimension

preconditions: new scope is a strict superset
postconditions: supersede target with broader scope
constitutional_constraints: scope expansion is privilege-bearing

preconditions: target type is CLAIM, BELIEF or ACTION
belief has no active contradiction/undercut and evidence is bound as support
postconditions: supersede target with VERIFIED verification state
constitutional_constraints: integrity evidence and semantic verification remain distinct

postconditions: supersede target as INVALIDATED
constitutional_constraints: invalidation requires explicit reason binding

postconditions: supersede target as SUSPENDED
constitutional_constraints: suspension is distinct from invalidation or falsity

preconditions: trusted time is at or after expiry
postconditions: supersede target as EXPIRED
constitutional_constraints: host clock alone cannot establish expiry

preconditions: target is in a reevaluatable state
postconditions: supersede target ACTIVE and UNVERIFIED for renewed evaluation
constitutional_constraints: reevaluation does not erase prior revision

postconditions: supersede target with authorized adjudicated status
